content.title: Restrict slot visibility to chosen Abhyasis
content.intent: Publish a slot chosen for one linked Abhyasi; an unselected linked Abhyasi must not see it while the chosen Abhyasi can.
content.technique_notes: Negative/auth and list-membership exclusion; known unselected linked user is the negative witness. Strength=3 from auth/data-loss; three-way combinations belong to the valid-input sweep, not a license to infer other visibility rules. Under four-pair ceiling highest-risk privacy path.

content.title: Reject out-of-range slot duration and capacity
content.intent: On slot entry, try outside-range duration and capacity and observe validation errors for each field.
content.technique_notes: BVA output duration [0,4,5,6,239,240,241], capacity [0,1,2,49,50,51], plus empty/null; only out-of-range values 0,4,241 and 0,51 expect the sourced error. EQP puts equal-outcome failures in one parameterized path. 3-wise risk strength=3 (auth/data-loss judged for use case); no cross-product of independent invalid fields because error co-occurrence is unspecified.

content.title: Publish a default weekly slot
content.intent: Create and publish a dated slot in the preceptor's timezone with default duration, capacity, and all-linked visibility.
content.technique_notes: EQP valid class, state flow from planning to publication, timezone and defaults. Strength=3 from auth/data-loss; covering array on visibility [all linked,selected], duration [5,45,240], capacity [1,2,50] produced 18 combinations; the default representative all linked/45/1 is used here; selected is exercised separately. Uncovered valid cross-products are lower priority than distinct outcomes at the four-pair ceiling.

content.title: Copy the previous week's plan
content.intent: Copy an existing previous-week plan into the current week and find its slots in the current-week plan.
content.technique_notes: State-flow/CRUD copying and temporal week shift; strength=3 risk-judged, but no numerical cross-inputs apply. No evidence specifies duplicate-copy behavior or empty prior week, so neither is asserted.

judgements.rationale: [value_score] Four-pair limit ranked selected-visibility privacy first, numeric invalid boundary second, default publish third, copy fourth, email-only batching fifth, and later-email sixth. Dedupe found six survivors; cross-UC booking scenarios do not cover preceptor slot creation.

[self_critique] Profiles: web form validation applies only to sourced numeric limits; search/list applies to visibility but not undocumented pagination/sorting; state flow and CRUD apply to creation/copy, auth applies to linked visibility. API contract, mobile-native, permissions, upload, currency, perf, a11y specifics, responsiveness, idempotency, and notification inspection add no sourced oracle. Negative excluded viewer is explicitly present; avoid treating presence of selected slot alone as proof of restriction.
